question: How do I track a run?
answer: Open the Run tab, tap Start, and allow location access. Your route will appear on the map. Tap Pause to pause, then Stop to save the run.

question: How does AI Coach work?
answer: Allow camera access when you start an exercise. The app uses pose detection to give real-time form feedback and count reps. If the camera is unavailable, simulated mode still counts reps and gives tips.

question: Where is my data stored?
answer: Your workouts, runs, and profile are stored locally on this device. We do not send your data to external servers unless you use cloud backup (if enabled in Settings).

question: How do I get workout reminders?
answer: Go to Profile → Notifications and tap Enable notifications. You can manage reminders in your device settings.

question: How do I contact support?
answer: Use the contact form in Profile → Help & Support, or email us at the address shown there. We typically respond within 1–2 business days.
